title: Nutty Provencal Peanut Curry
description: A tangy, cheese-pull Provencal curry with nutty peanut sauce, baked peanut cookie crumb topping and low-sodium ingredients.
instructions: In a saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat until shimmering.
Add smoked paprika, cumin, and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in low-sodium soy sauce, lemon juice, and honey, simmering for 1 minute.
Stir in unsalted peanut butter until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Lower heat and pour the sauce into a baking dish, spreading evenly.
Arrange mozzarella slices over the sauce, then sprinkle crushed peanut butter cookies on top.
Bake in a preheated 375°F oven for 12 minutes until the cheese melts and the cookie crumbs toast.
Garnish with fresh rosemary before serving.
